subject: Short-term medical leave / phased return coordination - Vivek Kulkarni
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Mar 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Short-term medical leave & phased return for Vivek K.

Hi Stephanie / Laura —

I wanted to loop you in early. Vivek came to me yesterday and shared that he needs surgery in late March and will require a short medical leave followed by a gradual return-to-work plan. He provided a preliminary physician note indicating approximately 6–8 weeks of recovery, with a recommended phased ramp back over 3–4 weeks (reduced hours + WFH initially). I attached the note and a draft temporary coverage matrix I pulled together to keep his projects covered.

High-level ask: can HR confirm next steps for formal paperwork (FMLA, state leave forms if applicable), pay/benefits impacts, and whether we should open an accommodation plan now? Also flagging that Vivek is on the core infra on-call rotation; I propose reassigning his on-call weeks to Logan and Marcus for April–May. See attached spreadsheet.

Vivek — thank you for sharing. We’ll move quickly to make this as frictionless as possible. Please let me know if you want me to handle intake coordination with HR.

Next steps I propose:
- Stephanie: confirm required docs and intake URL + timeline
- Laura: confirm short-term coverage and whether we should backfill contractor support
- I’ll coordinate the team calendar and on-call swaps once HR confirms dates

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: medical_note_vivek.pdf, temporary_coverage_matrix.xlsx

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dr. Karen Mills <karen.mills@occhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Mar 2025 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term medical leave & phased return for Vivek K.

Hi Marissa — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments.

We can start intake immediately. Action items from People Ops / HR: 
1) Please ask Vivek to complete the HR medical intake form (link below) and to upload the physician documentation. That will allow us to confirm eligibility for FMLA and start formal paperwork.
2) We will send an employee packet (FMLA_packet.pdf attached) outlining benefits continuation, short-term disability (if applicable), and pay timelines.
3) We will work with you on an accommodation plan template once we have the physician detail about physical limitations and suggested work hours.

Important notes:
- Job-protected leave depends on tenure and eligibility; we’ll confirm after intake.
- If Vivek would like, we can provision a phased return (partial hours and WFH) as an interim accommodation while the formal paperwork is processed.

HR intake form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf-example-hr-intake

I’ve cc’d Dr. Karen in case Vivek prefers her occupational clinic to submit documentation directly (she can also clarify typical timelines for clearance).

I’ll follow up with a checklist and expected deadlines by EOD today.

—Stephanie Nguyen
People Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: FMLA_packet.pdf

Cc: Dr. Karen Mills <karen.mills@occhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Short-term medical leave & phased return for Vivek K.

Hi Marissa / Stephanie —

Thank you both for moving quickly and for making this straightforward. I’ve completed the HR intake form and uploaded the physician note (medical_note_vivek.pdf) this morning. My surgeon is aiming for an operation week of March 24; initial estimate is 6 weeks recovery with doctor clearance around the first week of May. Tentative return date I’m planning for is May 6, with a 3-week phased schedule: week 1 (25% remote hours, no on-call), week 2 (50%, limited on-call), week 3 (75% and resume normal duties). I’m open to adjusting based on the physician clearance and HR guidance.

A few clarifying asks for the team: 
- Can I remain on Slack for high-priority async check-ins during recovery?
- Will short-term disability be coordinated automatically once the FMLA packet is processed, or do I need to file separately?

Dr. Karen — appreciate if you can confirm whether the proposed phased schedule is typical and whether a formal clearance note will be provided before May 6.

Thanks again — I appreciate the support.

—Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Software Engineer (Infrastructure)
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: medical_note_vivek.pdf
